prompt: Camera locked off. The masked arcade worker stands perfectly still, square to the lens, gloved hands at his sides, the mask's white ring and red triangle steady and facing straight into camera throughout. Only the bunch of keys at his belt sways faintly. Behind him the young couple keep playing the claw machine, she working the controls, he leaning in to watch. Neon signs and game screens flicker softly in the background. Sound: arcade room tone, distant game music loops, coins dropping into a tray, a faint jingle of keys.
